title: Informational leaflets — Suggestions for internal layout
slide_intent: Teach editors to let information hierarchy guide a reader through an interior spread. Images, subsections and quotations each need their own reading space.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can sustain clarity inside a leaflet after the cover’s graphic elements have receded.
demonstration: A large spread pairs a text page and athlete portrait with a quotation over the image. Two smaller spreads compare a colored subsection and a mostly typographic page with a pull quote.
practical_value: Choose a background change for a subsection or a pull quote for a long text passage. Test the legibility of any text placed over a photograph.

content_islands.name: Reading guidance
content_islands.spec: Use a numbered left column to explain levels of type, margins, image overlays, section backgrounds and pull quotes.

content_islands.name: Photo-led spread
content_islands.spec: Place the larger interior spread at center. Keep the text page open and set the caption or quotation over a quieter area of the photograph.

content_islands.name: Alternative interiors
content_islands.spec: Stack two smaller spreads at right, one with a saturated subsection and one that uses type to distinguish a quotation.
